facts.fact: The Central African Republic's and the DRC's digital ministers, meeting in Moscow on 8 October 2026, agreed on the need to carry out the CAR-DRC fibre-optic interconnection to reach the Moanda cable landing, with no timetable or financing agreement announced.
Agence Ecofin describes the WACS submarine cable (in service 2012, South Africa to the UK) as serving several West and Southern African countries including the DRC, which lands at Moanda.
